configuration.title: Unity Plus
configuration.rename.overrideF2.descript: Controls whether F2 in C# files uses Unity Plus class/script rename before falling back to VS Code Rename Symbol.
configuration.rename.classFileSyncMode.d: Controls automatic C# top-level type/file name synchronization. Use on for safe single-type C# files or off to disable sync.
configuration.projectFiles.autoRefresh.d: Refresh Unity project files when C# files are created, moved, or deleted.
configuration.templates.csharpScriptFile: Workspace-relative or absolute template file path for Unity Plus C# script creation. Takes priority over unityPlus.templates.csharpScript.
configuration.templates.scriptableObject: Workspace-relative or absolute template file path for Unity Plus ScriptableObject creation. Takes priority over unityPlus.templates.scriptableObject.
configuration.templates.csharpScript.des: Template text for Unity Plus C# script creation. Supports ${className} and ${namespaceBlock}.
configuration.templates.scriptableObject: Template text for Unity Plus ScriptableObject creation. Supports ${className} and ${namespaceBlock}.
configuration.eventReferences.enabled.de: Show Unity serialized event references in C# files.
configuration.metaFiles.hideInExplorer.d: Hide Unity .meta files in the VS Code Explorer while keeping Unity Plus meta file actions available.
configuration.metaFiles.moveWithAsset.de: Move Unity .meta files with their asset files when assets are renamed or moved.
configuration.scan.includeScenesOutsideB: Scan scenes outside Unity Build Settings when looking for event references.
configuration.logging.level.description: Controls the verbosity of the Unity Plus output channel.
